name: Merge Drop
description: Drop fruits, merge equal ones into bigger ones and do not let the jar overflow.

description_i18n.es: Suelta frutas, junta las iguales para hacerlas más grandes y que no se desborde el tarro.

prompt: A fruit merging physics game like Suika: drop fruits into a jar, two equal fruits touching merge into a bigger one, game over when the jar overflows. Real 2D physics, cute faces on the fruits, next fruit preview, combo popups. Make it addictive and viral: a daily challenge, streak or progress that brings people back every day, very satisfying animations, haptics with Acornix.vibrate and sounds made with Web Audio, records saved with Acornix.db, and a Share button that draws a beautiful result card on a canvas with the result, the app name and a small footer Made with Acornix, then shares it with Acornix.files.share and the file name result.png. Polished, colorful, premium design.
author: gonzaroman
